title: Insurance Claim Services Deductible Terms Table
content:
Deductible terms of the Insurance Claim Services arrangements: whether the company collects the insured's deductible, when it falls due, how many installments are allowed and whether a card is accepted.

## Terms

- **Deductible collected by the company** — whether the carrier pays the company net of the deductible so the company collects the deductible from the insured, boolean.
- **Collection point** — when the deductible is due: at authorization (before work starts) or at final invoice.
- **Due days** — calendar days after the collection point by which the deductible must be paid, count.
- **Maximum installments** — maximum number of installments the deductible may be paid in, count.
- **Card accepted** — whether the deductible may be paid by credit or debit card, boolean.

## Table

| Arrangement | Collected by the company | Collection point | Due days | Maximum installments | Card accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | no | at final invoice | 30 | 1 | yes |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | yes | at final invoice | 30 | 1 | yes |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | yes | at authorization | 10 | 1 | yes |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | yes | at authorization | 10 | 1 | yes |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | no | at final invoice | 30 | 1 | yes |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | yes | at final invoice | 30 | 3 | no |

## Reading the table

- The two arrangements where the carrier pays the insured — Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support and Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing — show "no" in the first column.
- Only Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration allows more than one installment (up to 3), and it is the one arrangement that does not accept a card.
- Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing and Carrier Program Claim Billing collect at authorization with 10 days to pay; the others collect at final invoice with 30 days.
